Bewitching Bar
Feb 2025 • Friends
Top hole drinking spot in the crowded Saigon scene, Arth is in a niche in itself. Inconspicuously hidden in an old shophouse, the ambience of the place is modern, elegant and cozy.
Prices may be steeper than your average Saigon cocktail bar, but I do think you get what you pay for! It's definitely one of those places you should visit in Saigon for a classy night out - the drinks are created with so much passion and creativity, while the hospitality and service at the bar is pretty world-class.
